summary: Deep analysis of k+1 backward direction revealed the root cause: the formula nf_exist_formula does not encode the quantifier part of sub_nf, and the composition theorem (2-var NF determined by 1-var NFs + order) is FALSE at all depths >= 1. The formula must be replaced with an interval-based formula using nested Until/Since chains (buildRight/buildLeft from Translation.lean) that explicitly encode both atoms and quantifiers of sub_nf. This requires generalizing P2 to all arities P2_n(k), with the dependency chain P2_2(k+1) <- P2_3(k) <- ... <- P2_{k+3}(0). Estimated ~750 lines of new code. No approaches explored (NF-transfer, classical good_nf, composition theorem) can circumvent the need for explicit interval formula construction.
blockers: Task 3.4c: The formula nf_exist_formula is the wrong formula for P2(k+1). Must be replaced with an interval-based formula that encodes sub_nf.2 via nested Until/Since. Requires ~750 lines implementing P2_n(k) for all arities.
